_about: Facts about listed companies that the market source does not give, kept by hand. Each entry is keyed by exchange code and ticker. Fill only what a primary source confirms (issuer announcement, exchange notice) and note it in `source`. `sector` groups comparable securities of the same exchange; `listings` are the other places the security trades, with the number of local shares one depositary receipt stands for.
